title: Why Rich Indians Love to Steal?
description:
India ranks high among the world’s most charitable nations. But there’s another list where we rank embarrassingly high—stealing from hotels, flights, public property, and even food banks abroad. And the shocking part? Many of these incidents involve well-off, educated, financially stable Indians.

From families caught stuffing hotel rooms into suitcases, to people stealing life jackets from flights, to luxury car owners taking public flower pots, this isn’t poverty. It’s a mindset. A scarcity mentality mixed with zero civic sense and even less accountability. “We paid for it, might as well take something extra” — that thinking is more common than we admit.

In this video, we decode why this behavior feels normal to some, how lack of consequences fuels it, and why empathy is missing from the equation. This is not about calling all Indians thieves. It’s about calling out a mentality that damages our global image and erodes trust within society itself.

Watch till the end before judging.
